title: ^NUCLEAR PROJECT MANAGEMENT AND PROFESSIONAL COMMUNICATION
description: Equips students with the knowledge and skills necessary to effectively plan, execute, oversee, and communicate projects to different nuclear science and engineering stakeholders. Covers a wide range of topics related to project management, communication, and research specifically tailored to the unique challenges and requirements of nuclear projects. Involves regular writing and research as it relates to nuclear science and engineering.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: WR 227Z, 227HZ, 327 or 327H.
A minimum grade of C is required in WR 227Z, WR 227HZ, WR 327 and WR 327H.

Enrollment limited to students in the College of Engineering college.
